name: ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQL5A 2K QHD 210Hz Gaming Monitor adjustable stand
shortDescription: ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQL5A 27-inch 2K QHD Gaming Monitor adjustable stand (2560x1440 / Fast IPS Panel / Ultra Fast 210Hz Refresh Rate / 0.3ms Min Response Time / 130% sRGB & 95% DCI-P3 / VESA DisplayHDR 400 & Free
descriptionHtml:
ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQL5A 27-inch 2K QHD Gaming Monitor adjustable stand (2560x1440 / Fast IPS Panel / Ultra Fast 210Hz Refresh Rate / 0.3ms Min Response Time / 130% sRGB & 95% DCI-P3 / VESA DisplayHDR 400 & FreeSync Premium / Full Ergonomic Stand / Built-in Speakers / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Experience blazing fast fluid gameplay and vibrant visuals with the ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQL5A 27-inch 2K QHD gaming monitor featuring a fully ergonomic adjustable stand, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Engineered with a 27-inch Fast IPS panel delivering sharp 2560x1440 resolution, extreme 210Hz refresh rate, and up to 0.3ms minimum response time (1ms GTG), this monitor eliminates motion blur via ELMB Sync technology. Outfitted with 130% sRGB color spectrum, VESA DisplayHDR 400 certification, AMD FreeSync Premium, and integrated 2Wx2 stereo speakers, its versatile height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustable stand ensures maximum ergonomic comfort during extended gaming sessions.
